# Programme Baselines — conveyor buildout

Programme Baselines for the conveyor buildout programme (standard MSP, §8.3). The record holds three baseline records, one per baseline kind, taken on 2026-11-21 by conveyor-e2e and approved by conveyor-approver. All three records capture the same programme snapshot: programme 01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac ('conveyor buildout') with 48 projects and 14 tranches.
